desc:
SERESGENUS: EPHEMERALITY 

A Voxel Roguelike Adventure

Travel across six unique worlds, each with its own enemies, resources, secrets, and powerful boss to defeat. Explore, grow stronger, and uncover hidden worlds that go beyond the main adventure.

- Fight & Progress
Battle unique enemies, challenge powerful regional bosses, collect better equipment, and choose from different classes to shape your playstyle.

- Gather, Craft & Build
Gather resources from the worlds you explore, craft weapons and gear, and build your own base to store your treasures and prepare for your next expedition.

- Find the Unknown
Search for hidden areas, rare discoveries, and secret worlds. There's more to Seresgenus than what's immediately visible.

- Solo or Co-op
Take on the adventure alone or bring your friends along. Explore together, gather resources, build bases, and fight your way through the worlds as a party.


(Game Is Still In Beta Expect Bugs)
